scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev -w packages/backend" "npm run dev -w packages/frontend"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:push -w packages/backend && npm run prisma:seed -w packages/backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,green" "npm run start -w packages/backend" "npm run preview -w packages/frontend"
